✨ A Golden Moment for I-FEST² ✨

GUESS WHO JOINED ATAST FAMILY ? 🤔

We are delighted to welcome LIYSF (London International Youth Science Forum) as our Gold Sponsor Partner !

Your support strengthens our mission to bring culture and technology together and makes IFEST² an even richer and more inspiring experience for all attendees.

Thank you LIYSF , for believing in a world where diversity is celebrated and partnerships thrive. 🌍🤝
